data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Doris was a sea-goddess, personification of the sea. In the Bible, Dorcas was a disciple who was raised from the dead by Saint Tabitha. The name Dorisa means 'gift of God'. The name Dorisa carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dorisa usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: דּוֹרִיסָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דּוֹרִיסָה היא שֵם הַנְשִׁיקָה שֶׁל הַסְּעִיד, הַמְיֻחֶד בְּהַכְנָסַת, שָׂחַק, וְדָוָא. לְפִיכָך, דּוֹרִיסָה הִיא נְשִׁיקָה שֶׁל הַסְּעִיד, הַמְלַוְּדָה לוֹ־שָׁלוֹם. בְּעַצְמָהּ, דּוֹרִיסָה הִיא שֵם שֶׁל נְשִׁיקָה, אֲבָל בְּפִירוּשׁ, הִיא הִיא שֵם שֶׁל יְשוּעָה, שֶׁל טְלִיהָ, וּשְׁל קְדוּשָׁה.

in_greek.name: Δωρίσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Δωρίσα είναι ένα όνομα που σημαίνει ευφημία, ή μια γέννηση που αναδεικνύει την ευλογία. Θα μπορούσαμε να πούμε ότι είναι μια γέννηση που επιβεβαιώνει την επικείμενη ευλογία, ή μια γέννηση που αναδεικνύει την ελπίδα στην ανακάλυψη. Η Δωρίσα είναι επίσης συνδεδεμένη με την ιδέα της ευχαρίστησης και της ευχαριστίας, καθώς το όνομα προέρχεται από τη λέξη 'δωρέω', που σημαίνει 'δωρίζω' ή 'σchenώ'.

in_english.long_meaning: Dorisa is a name derived from the Greek word 'doron', meaning gift. In Christian tradition, the name Dorisa signifies the gift of joy, the gift of love, and the gift of salvation. It is a name that conveys the idea of a precious and treasured gift, one that brings happiness and fulfillment to those who receive it. As a given name, Dorisa is often associated with qualities such as kindness, generosity, and compassion, making it a fitting choice for parents who value these traits in their child.

data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, the name Dorisa holds immense spiritual significance as it is associated with the biblical figure of Dorcas, a disciple who was brought back to life by Saint Tabitha. It serves as an inspiration to have faith in the power of God to bring about miracles and healing in our lives.

Additionally, Dorisa signifies the journey of continuous growth and transformation, as the name Dorothea means "redeeming" or "redeemed".
